notes: Empty arg yields "What do you want to drop?".
get_obj_in_list_vis miss yields "You don't seem to have a/an X.".
drop all with empty inventory yields "You don't seem to be carrying anything.".
drop all drops the whole inventory in order.
drop all. yields "What do you want to drop all of?".
drop all.X with no match yields "You don't seem to have any Xss.".
drop all.X drops each matching item.
drop N <noncoin> yields "Sorry, you can't do that to more than one item at a time.".
C do_drop parses with one_argument (fill-skip + lowercase); Go doDrop uses strings.Fields. Drop-local routing fix.
NODROP object below immort yields "You can't drop $p, it must be CURSED!".
Room ondrop trigger (RS_ONDROP, 1<<3) fires after a successful drop.
drop 0 coins yields "Heh heh heh.. we are jolly funny today, eh?".
Dropping more coins than held yields "You don't have that many coins!".
Actor "You drop some gold." and room "$n drops <money_desc>."; WAIT_STATE.

all. -> FIND_ALLDOT shared with get; proven under the get manifest.
